records.title: Hormuz traffic dips to lowest since May after US, Iranian strikes on ships
records.claim: Kpler reported a 10-day average of 10 commodity ships/day through Hormuz, lowest since May; no VLCC had exited since Wednesday.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Hormuz traffic dips to lowest since May after US, Iranian strikes on ships

records.boundary: Traffic counts are vessel counts and do not directly equal energy volume.

records.title: Oil extends gains after US and Iran strike ships
records.claim: Brent was $96.80/bbl and WTI $92.14/bbl; prices extended gains amid renewed vessel strikes and reduced Hormuz flows.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Oil extends gains after US and Iran strike ships

records.boundary: Snapshot futures values, not settlement and not LNG/LPG price proxies.

records.title: Ship fuel shortage looms as refiners strained by war favour other products
records.data_period: Q3 2026 outlook; inventory and price observations through Sep 1
records.claim: Fuel oil deficit forecast at 218 kbpd in Q3; key hub stocks around 30% below seasonal averages; Singapore VLSFO up 76% since war began.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Ship fuel shortage looms as refiners strained by war favour other products

records.boundary: Consultancy forecasts and Sep 1 price data; not a Sep 7 live bunker assessment.

records.title: OPEC+ keeps oil output policy unchanged for October
records.claim: Seven OPEC+ members kept October oil output policy unchanged; actual production remains below targets due to war constraints.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: OPEC+ keeps oil output policy unchanged for October

records.boundary: Policy targets do not guarantee production or exports.
